The `makedepends` includes `wget`, which is expected for downloading the source archive.

No obfuscated code, suspicious commands (e.g., `eval`, `base64`, `curl|bash`), or unexpected behaviors are present. The license is custom but distributed with the package as required. All operations are consistent with the stated purpose of installing legacy fonts. There is no evidence of malicious or unintended activity.
